en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5444 - It is narrated from Abdullah ibn Muhammad Al-Hajjal from Thaʿlabah ibn Maymun from Muhammad ibn Qays, who said:

I asked Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) about a man who gives preference to some of his children over others.
Imam (as) replied: "Yes, and he may also favor some of his wives (over other wives)."
